Overview

Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Insurance & Risk earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from policy admin platforms and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. The Insurance & Risk operating reality gives this work its shape: loss ratios pressure at event speed, Solvency II reporting obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
